damage.source: GOB 243 stores fixed Ballistic 16 for its landed Handguns special.
damage.runtime: The queued hit uses that base, current Ballistic influence and recipient stat181 resistance.
damage.test: Stock PR894 landed 17 on the original target and raw17/final15 after the target gained 181 +20. PistolAerialLandsItsFixedBaseAgainstBallisticResistance tests those typed influences. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110

targeting.source: GOB 243 requires a loaded Handguns special within its interlock and a live original opponent in range and sight.
targeting.runtime: The normal handler admits the current view and spawn, then preserves the same fight and opponent when it queues.
targeting.test: The ordinary request tests exercise unloaded, rest, stale, range, blocked sight and valid admission. Native PR894 locally blocked the at-rest cast. The active interlock emitted the original QAEnemy handle during the attempted other-target step. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110

proc.source: GOB ApplyStunWithTimer sets a 40% landed chance and four-second Stun with associated immunity records.
proc.runtime: The landed conditional modifier uses the stored chance and the live immunity state. On immunity it emits only the brief marker and keeps the existing immunity until its registered expiry.
proc.test: PistolAerialUsesItsOwnStoredStunRollAndFourSecondImmunity checks both chance sides. The disclosed stock run forces the modifier branch and observes ordinary contest misses, then a landed stack, a separate immunity refusal, and one paired retirement of the held immunity. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110

script.source: ApplyStunWithTimer specifies the marker, four-second Stun and immunity with caster feedback, including the lower-stacking refusal to the caster.
script.runtime: TimedEffects publishes the captured marker, Stun and linked stat163 -20, and the independent 734/681 record. The refusal uses one private visible notice with the same meaning. The original numeric localization remains unverified.
script.test: PistolAerialSendsTheArchivedLinkedStunAndMessageOrder, PistolAerialTermMarkerUsesTheArchivedTargetlessAddAndRemoveFrames and PistolAerialRepeatDuringImmunityKeepsTheExistingStackUntilExpiry verify the wire stack. Stock PR894 saw the messages, paired removals and one private refusal without reapplying immunity. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110

source-parity.source: GOB 243 supplies fixed 16 and TacticBonus +19. The known success binding is 9518. Archived player packets show the linked Stun, -20 and immunity ordering.
source-parity.runtime: The queued Ballistic route adds the +19 once under the documented PR922 policy and uses 9518 on a hit. The script refusal and effect ordering use the captured state records and equivalent caster feedback.
source-parity.test: Native PR894 observed base33→52, 9518, the two typed outcomes, both Stun outcomes and unchanged 40 s immunity record 300 on refusal. The scope leaves the original refusal localization metadata qualified. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110

behavior-tests.source: GOB 243 has 20 IS, own/group 10/5 s, Handguns selected interlock, Ballistic 16, tactic +19, and optional four-second Stun.
behavior-tests.runtime: The ordinary admission, selected fight identity, typed hit, 9518, and conditional Stun/expiry path together consume the authored inputs.
behavior-tests.test: Executable admission, damage, RNG threshold, record and expiry checks combine with stock PR894 cost/reuse, natural contest misses, two landed damage variants, immune hold isolation and the private notice. QAOther received no matching records. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110

controls.source: ApplyStunWithTimer and the retained player records specify a four-second Stun with linked Combat Tactics -20 and independent 734/681 immunity. The original marker is an instantaneous trigger.
controls.runtime: TimedEffects manages the Stun, linked modifier and immunity as distinct records. Active immunity retains its source record and expiry and declines a second Stun. The common Stun state uses the existing ability and attack gates.
controls.test: Stock PR894 sees the paired four-second linked Stun and immunity removals, then only the transient marker and one refusal while held record 300 stays active until its original expiry. PistolAerialRepeatDuringImmunityKeepsTheExistingStackUntilExpiry proves exact replacement denial. PR921 separately witnesses the shared Stun gate and recovery. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/921#issuecomment-7092064206

243.note: PR894 uses a visible server-owned refusal preserving the authored recipient and meaning. The original numeric string ID was not recovered. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/894#issuecomment-7092426110
